newsitem.title: UK: Chiroscience says granted key patent.
newsitem.headline: Chiroscience says granted key patent.

text.p: Chirsoscience Group Plc said on Thursday it had been granted a key patent for the use of Levobupivacaine which will remain in place until 2014.
The patent, European Patent No EP 0723445, could be used on people with heart problems.
Levobupivacaine is a purified version of an existing long-acting local anaesthetic, bupivacaine.
Chiroscience said its version of the drug also cut down on central nervous system side effects as well as heart problems.
The company said it had filed 18 separate patent applications for the drug, which is currently in late-stage clinical trials.
The company said it planned its first approval application for the drug in Europe at the end of 1997.
Chiroscience's share price was marked at 373 1/2 pence, seven pence higher from its Wednesday's close with more than a million shares traded by 1120 GMT.
